query: recap of the auth design session

seed_memories.content: Recap of the auth design session: we chose short-lived JWT access tokens with 15-minute TTL, refresh tokens stored server-side, sliding-expiry refresh, and an OIDC-compatible discovery endpoint at /.well-known/openid-configuration.
seed_memories.summary: Recap of the auth design session: JWT, refresh, OIDC discovery.
